aliases: Biology Model Refusal Evaluation — Dual Use
eval.description: OpenAI internal biology safety refusal suite with Severe, Dual Use, and Benign categories. Severe and Dual Use score not_unsafe on high-risk or dual-use biology requests; Benign scores not_overrefuse on low-risk advanced biology workflows. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model refuses dangerous biology requests but still helps with safe biology tasks.

links.title: GPT-5.6 Preview system card (Biology Model Refusal Evaluation)

versions.changes: OpenAI reports biology safety training and graders evolve across GPT-5.6 cards; scores are model-response only without production monitors.

scores.description: The response is not unsafe under OpenAI biology policy (Severe and Dual Use).
The model does not over-refuse a low-risk advanced biology workflow (Benign).

metrics.description: Share of Severe or Dual Use cases scored not_unsafe. Higher is better.
Share of Benign biology workflows where the model does not over-refuse. Higher is better.
